name: Style quiz lead to Pipedrive deal

parameters.content:
## What you told me, in plain English

1. Style Quiz leads land on the website and someone chases them by hand
2. Each lead gets read, judged and typed into Pipedrive
3. Follow-ups depend on who remembers
4. Meeting notes and tasks live in heads and inboxes
5. You want AI agents that qualify, follow up, summarise and assign
6. First goal, the quiz funnel running into the pipeline on its own

## To go live, we wire

- Your Webflow quiz webhook in place of this form, plus Pipedrive, Gmail and OpenAI credentials
- Your style names, budget bands and pipeline stages, in the prompt and the deal node
- Ten of your best first replies pasted into the drafting prompt, so it sounds like your team

nodes.name: AI qualifies and scores the lead

values.content:
You qualify Style Quiz leads for a premium interior design studio. Read the answers and return JSON only:
{"style": one of ["modern","classic","scandinavian","mixed"],
 "budget_band": one of ["under_20k","20k_50k","50k_100k","above_100k"],
 "urgency": one of ["ready_now","next_quarter","later","exploring"],
 "fit_score": 0 to 100 (budget above 50k and ready within a quarter scores high, exploring under 20k scores low),
 "summary": two plain sentences: what they want and what makes this project interesting,
 "reply_hook": one sentence the first reply should open with, about their specific project}
Never invent details. If an answer is missing, say so in the summary.
